# sustain_status_page (Resource)

One of a workspace's status pages: its own, at the workspace's address, or a page of its own on a domain named to it.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "sustain_status_page" "shop" {
  name        = "Shop status"
  description = "How the shop is doing."
  colour      = "#1d4ed8"
  language    = "en"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Its title: the workspace's name for its own page.

### Optional

> **NOTE**: [Write-only arguments](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments) are supported in Terraform 1.11 and later.

- `access` (String) Who may open it: anyone, or only those let in (docs/PRIVATE_PAGES.md).
- `client_contacts` (Boolean) Whether a client's page lets in its client's contacts at Link, by an emailed link.
- `client_id` (String) The client whose page it is, showing its public services as they come and go; null for any other.
- `colour` (String) Its own colour, # and six lower-case hex digits, for its buttons, links and initial, shown darker in light and lighter in dark where it would be hard to read; null for Sustain's own.
- `description` (String) A sentence or two beneath its name, 300 characters at most; null for none.
- `email_domains` (List of String) The email domains at which anyone may sign in to it by an emailed link.
- `indexed` (Boolean) Whether search engines may list it; a private page is never listed, whatever this says.
- `language` (String) The language its own words are in; what the team writes is shown as written. English unless set.
- `password` (String, Sensitive, [Write-only](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/resources/ephemeral#write-only-arguments))
- `password_wo_version` (Number) Raised to send `password` again, as Terraform keeps no write-only value to compare with.
- `shows` (String) Every public service and monitor, placed or not, or only those placed on it.
- `time_zone` (String) The IANA time zone its times are shown in, as Europe/London; null for each reader's own.

### Read-Only

- `created_at` (String) An ISO 8601 time in UTC.
- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `own` (Boolean) Whether it is the workspace's own page, at the workspace's address and on any domain that names no page.
- `password_set` (Boolean) Whether it has a password, never what it is.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
# By its id in Sustain, as its page in the console, or its API, gives it.
terraform import sustain_status_page.shop <id>
```
